steps.domain_action: Initialize the system with an arbitrary positive integer n.
Branch the state based on the parity of n.
Affirm the even branch; prepare for contraction.
Apply the n/2 operation to reduce the state.
Record the contraction step in the trajectory.
Rejoin the even branch to the main flow.
Branch the state based on the parity of the new n.
Affirm the odd branch; prepare for expansion.
Apply the 3n+1 operation to increase the state.
Record the expansion step in the trajectory.
Rejoin the odd branch to the main flow.
Compose the sequence of operations to form the full trajectory.
Self-reference the critical threshold where expansion and contraction balance.
Hold the paradoxical state of a non-terminating orbit that never reaches 1.
Permanently fix the hypothesis of a divergent cycle.
Anchor the system in the boundary of the non-terminating orbit.
